findings.claim: Real camera and tracker noises share the common-mode covariance assumed here, or are independent
findings.value: not established: the cross-correlation is a declared synthetic parameter

hypothesis: NEES/NIS consistency holds for a filter whose R matches the truth, whether the sensor noises are correlated or independent, and fails in either direction of mismatch: dropping a real cross-covariance makes the filter overconfident while its mean NIS still passes, and assuming an absent one makes it underconfident while its NIS fails; the size of each failure follows from an exact moment recursion.
input_data: one set of correlated readings and one set of independent readings of the same truth
mathematical_model: Camera and tracker positions z_c = p + e_m + e_c, z_t = p + e_m + e_t. Correlated truth: Var e_c = Var e_t = 0.04 I, common mode Var e_m = 0.09 I, R_true = [[0.13 I, 0.09 I], [0.09 I, 0.13 I]]. Independent truth: no common mode, R = blockdiag(0.13 I, 0.13 I) (same marginal variances). Each truth is filtered with both R. CV motion dt = 0.1 s, q = 0.05. Mismatched moments: joint [x; x_hat] mean and covariance propagated exactly tick by tick (mismatch_moments).
numerical_result: Correlated noise, correct R: ANEES inside 0.98 of ticks, grand NEES 4.066, NIS 4.002. Correlation ignored: ANEES above bound 1.00 of ticks, grand NEES 5.514; grand NIS 3.917 (passes); whitened max |z| 84.7 vs 3.89. Independent noise, block-diagonal R: ANEES inside 0.98, grand NEES 3.962. Correlation assumed: ANEES below bound 0.99 of ticks (grand 3.137), ANIS above bound 1.00 (grand 7.723), exact RMSE 0.1722 m vs 0.1697 m.
observation_model: Stacked 4-vector measurement at every tick; filter prior equals the truth prior.

physical_validation_status.statement: Physical validation requires acquired hardware evidence; none was acquired for this task.

uncertainty: Per-tick intervals are exact chi-square quantiles; the fraction-inside threshold 0.9 allows for time correlation of NEES. Moment agreement uses run-level standard errors.
